mapper.select: SELECT current_run_id FROM study_rooms WHERE id=#{roomId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT current_run_id FROM study_rooms WHERE id=#{roomId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, user_id, chapter_id, title, initial_question, summary, current_step_id, version, created_at, updated_at FROM study_rooms WHERE id=#{roomId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT id, step_key, step_type, title, explanation, evidence_json, resources_json, step_order, supplemental, parent_step_id, created_at, orchestration_json FROM study_room_steps WHERE study_room_id=#{roomId} AND run_id=(SELECT current_run_id FROM study_rooms WHERE id=study_room_id) ORDER BY step_order, id

SELECT id, role, content, sources_json, step_id, created_at FROM study_room_messages WHERE study_room_id=#{roomId} AND run_id=(SELECT current_run_id FROM study_rooms WHERE id=study_room_id) ORDER BY message_order
mapper.update: UPDATE study_rooms SET version=version+1, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{roomId}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(message_order),-1)+1 FROM study_room_messages WHERE study_room_id=#{roomId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO study_room_messages (id, study_room_id, message_order, role, content, sources_json, step_id, created_at, run_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{roomId}, #{messageOrder}, #{role}, #{content}, #{sourcesJson}, #{stepId}, #{createdAt}, (SELECT current_run_id FROM study_rooms WHERE id=#{roomId}))
mapper.update: UPDATE study_rooms SET current_step_id=NULL, version=version+1, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{roomId} AND user_id=#{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT source_path FROM knowledge_chunks k JOIN chapters c ON c.id = k.chapter_id WHERE k.chapter_id = #{chapterId} AND (k.source_path LIKE 'textbook/%' OR k.source_path LIKE 'courseware/%') AND k.review_status = 'VERIFIED' AND k.resource_id IS NULL AND k.license_scope IN ('PUBLIC','CLASSROOM_ONLY') AND c.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY source_path
